The Outsiders Wednesday Social Ride

Louisville, KY · Social · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

The Outsiders Wednesday Social Ride is a social and road group ride in Louisville, KY. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:45 pm from Trellis Brewing. About 10–20 miles, 10–12 mph, peppy social. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @outsiderscycling502 the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Outsiders Wednesday Social Ride group ride

Louisville's largest social ride. Every rider, every bike, no one left behind. Ten to twenty miles at a conversational pace with rotating stops around the city.
